overview.title: 1. Overview
overview.description: BookingCare's refund policy is designed to ensure the rights of both patients and healthcare facilities. This policy applies to all medical appointments made through the BookingCare platform.

refundRules.title: 2. Refund Rules Based on Cancellation Time
refundRules.description: The refund amount is calculated based on the time from cancellation to the scheduled appointment time:

refund100.title: 100% Refund
refund100.description: When canceling the appointment more than 24 hours before the scheduled appointment time
refund100.exampleValue: If your appointment is at 2:00 PM on January 15, you need to cancel before 2:00 PM on January 14 to receive a 100% refund.

refund50.title: 50% Refund
refund50.description: When canceling the appointment between 12 and 24 hours before the scheduled appointment time
refund50.exampleValue: If your appointment is at 2:00 PM on January 15, canceling from 2:00 PM on January 14 to 2:00 AM on January 15 will result in a 50% refund.

refund0.title: No Refund
refund0.description: When canceling the appointment less than 12 hours before the scheduled appointment time
refund0.exampleValue: If your appointment is at 2:00 PM on January 15, canceling after 2:00 AM on January 15 will not receive a refund.

hospitalCancel.subtitle: 3.1. Cancellation by Hospital/Doctor
hospitalCancel.title: 100% Refund
hospitalCancel.description1: If the appointment is canceled by the hospital or doctor (due to reasons from the healthcare facility), you will receive a 100% refund of the paid amount, regardless of cancellation time.
hospitalCancel.description2: In this case, BookingCare will automatically process the refund and notify you via email or SMS.

pastAppointment.subtitle: 3.2. Past Appointments
pastAppointment.description: You cannot cancel appointments that have passed the appointment time. If you do not show up without prior notice, you will not receive a refund.

items.title: Cancel Request
items.description: You cancel the appointment through the BookingCare app or website

items.title: Automatic Calculation
items.description: The system will automatically calculate the refund amount based on cancellation time

items.title: Confirmation
items.description: You will receive a notification about the refund amount and processing time

items.title: Processing
items.description: BookingCare will process the refund within 5-7 business days

items.title: Receive Money
items.description: Money will be refunded to the account or original payment method

refundMethods.title: 5. Refund Methods
refundMethods.description: Money will be refunded according to the original payment method:

items.creditCardValue: Refund to card account (5-7 business days)
items.bankTransferValue: Refund to bank account (3-5 business days)

refundMethods.noteValue: The time to receive money may vary depending on the bank or payment service provider.

processingFee.title: 6. Processing Fee
processingFee.description1: BookingCare does not charge a refund processing fee. The full refund amount will be calculated according to the specified refund rate (100%, 50%, or 0%).
processingFee.description2: However, if there are fees from the bank or payment service provider, these fees will be deducted from the refund amount.

complaints.title: 7. Complaints and Support
complaints.description: If you have any questions or complaints about refunds, please contact us:
complaints.commitment: We commit to responding to all requests within 24 hours and handling complaints fairly and transparently.

noRefundCases.title: 8. Cases Not Eligible for Refund
noRefundCases.description: You will not receive a refund in the following cases:
items: Canceling the appointment less than 12 hours before the appointment time
Not showing up without prior notice
Service already used (already had the appointment)
Violating BookingCare or healthcare facility regulations
Fraud or use of invalid information

policyChanges.title: 9. Policy Changes
policyChanges.description: BookingCare reserves the right to update or change this refund policy. Any changes will be announced on the website with the latest update date. The new policy will apply to appointments made after the update date.

additionalTerms.title: 10. Additional Terms
additionalTerms.description1: This refund policy is part of BookingCare's Terms of Use. By using the service, you agree to the terms in this policy.
additionalTerms.description2: In case of conflict between the refund policy and other terms, the refund policy will take precedence for refund-related issues.

importantNote.title: Important Note
importantNote.description: Cancellation time is calculated in UTC timezone. Please check the time carefully before canceling to ensure you receive the correct refund amount.
